source: Published plasma-wave parameters: Van Allen Probes EMFISIS, Juno Waves, Cassini RPWS, Voyager 1 PWS

worlds.name: Earth
worlds.fact: Dawn chorus: rising whistles at 0.1–0.5 of the electron cyclotron frequency, about 7 kHz at four Earth radii
worlds.reference: Kletzing et al. 2013; Santolík et al. 2003

worlds.name: Jupiter
worlds.fact: Lightning whistlers: tones that fall as low frequencies arrive later, measured by Juno near Jupiter's poles

worlds.name: Saturn
worlds.fact: Saturn kilometric radiation, 100–400 kHz, pulsing with a period of about 10.7 hours

worlds.name: Voyager 1
worlds.fact: Interstellar plasma oscillations near 2.6 kHz, implying about 0.08 electrons per cm³ beyond the heliopause
